critical_illness.value: Three options: Silver (10 critical illnesses), Gold (25), Platinum (64). Minor critical illness (5 minor conditions): the lower of 25% of rider sum assured or Rs 5,00,000, and the rider continues for the balance. Major: 100% of rider sum assured less minor claims paid, lump sum if the life survives 14 days; the rider then ends.
